FN-PVB5EGE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 68
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 68 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of local governing
bodies to enter into mutual aid agreements with public or private agencies within the state for
reciprocal emergency management aid and assistance in case of disasters and reciprocal aid and
assistance to protect the peace, health and safety of the public.
